messages.subject: Meridian Trade Park - building survey findings
messages.plaintextBody:
Helena,

My report is in the data room. Headline: the estate is fair-to-good overall, but there is active water ingress to the Unit 2 roof (failed laps, corroded fixings). I'd budget £68k-£78k plus VAT for localised overcladding and repairs rather than a full replacement. The Phase 1 roofs (Units 1, 3-5) will need refurbishment in 5-8 years.

Happy to discuss. Roger Calderbank, Calderbank Vine

Helena,

Agreed - a £75k retention with release on your surveyor certifying the works is cleaner than a price chip and keeps the headline number intact for the lender. I'll put it to Castle & Vane and build it into the contract as a Schedule 5 mechanism.

James
